push.title: W 1-0 vs Sacks N Racks | You: 8.6
push.body:
buddskees, an 8.6. Good enough to be proud of, close enough to great to be hungry.

THE GOOD
+ A goal against Sacks N Racks. Defenders can draw up all the plans they want; you just scored anyway.
+ Man of the Match, your 19th for us. MOTM. Put it on the fridge and the resume.
+ 7th straight match at 7.5 match rating. Gold star, no notes.
+ Passes attempted 36, up from your usual 25. Keep that in your back pocket.
+ Team-high 1 key passes. You earned that one the honest way.

THE BAD
- Tackle success 0%, down from your usual 57%. Let's try: Show them down the line, toward the touchline and away from goal, then strike.
- Giveaways 12, up from your usual 7. That has to tighten up.
- Shots: 1. Top tier forwards post 3+. Let's join 'em.
- Key passes: 1. A few steps from the 2+ club.

Muscle memory: Stay on your feet. Slide only when you're certain of the ball and there's somebody behind you.

buddskees, you already know this, but I'll say it anyway: There's no 'I' in team, but there's a 'me' if you scramble it. Don't scramble it.

We'll get there together. - Coach Lasso

push.title: W 1-0 vs Sacks N Racks | You: 6.8 (5th worst match performance of the season)
push.body:
PhogsToffees, a 6.8 against Sacks N Racks is your 5th worst match performance of the season. The comeback starts tomorrow.

THE GOOD
+ 1 assist. You were the playmaker, the matchmaker and the good-time maker.
+ You and buddskees play like you've known each other since kindergarten.
+ Team-high 4 tackles attempted. Little things like that are big things in disguise.
+ 1 shot on target chipped in +0.1. Every bit helps.
+ We beat Sacks N Racks 1-0. Wins taste better when everybody chipped in.

THE BAD
- 59% passing (16 of 27, down from your usual 77%). Fundamentals: Through balls only when the runner is already moving and on the last defender's shoulder. That's a promise.
- Shots on target 1, down from your usual 3. Bread and butter: Tight angle? Cut it back to a teammate. A better shot beats a first shot.
- Tackle success 0%, down from your usual 31%. Next match: Every missed tackle leaves a runner free behind you. If you're not sure, contain and let cover arrive.

THE UGLY
! Match rating 6.8, down from your usual 8.6. That's not football. That's spectating in boots.

Training-ground special: A sideways pass that keeps the ball is worth more than a forward one that loses it.

Last thing, PhogsToffees. Practice like you're second, play like you're first.

I believe in you, period. - Coach Lasso

players.name: BellyTb1

weaknesses.detail: Pass accuracy: 62% (bottom quarter of forwards is 73% or less)
weaknesses.title: Passing accuracy
tips: With your back to goal, shield it and set it back to the runner facing play. Turning into traffic is a coin flip.
Scan before the ball gets to you - a quick shoulder check means you already know the pass before you need it.
Open your hips to the field when you receive. Side-on body shape turns a back pass into a forward one.
weaknesses.coach: The passing got a little loose out there.

weaknesses.detail: Shots on target: 0% (bottom quarter of forwards is 60% or less)
weaknesses.title: Shot selection
tips: Shoot from central, inside the box. Tight angles and long range are where shots go wide.
Set your feet first if you've got a half second. Off-balance shots fly into the stands.
Tight angle? Cut it back to a teammate. A better shot beats a first shot.
weaknesses.coach: A few too many shots went wide or over. Better looks, better results.

push.title: W 1-0 vs Sacks N Racks | You: 5.5 (worst match performance of the season)
push.body:
A 5.5 against Sacks N Racks, BellyTb1. Your worst match performance of the season. We'll get you back.

THE GOOD
+ Misplaced passes 3, down from your usual 7. Keep stacking those bricks.
+ Team-high 2 shots. Remember that the next time you doubt yourself.
+ Team-high 1 tackles won. I see you, and I like what I see.
+ We beat Sacks N Racks 1-0. Wins are better when they're shared.

THE BAD
- 62% passing (5 of 8, down from your usual 76%). Let's sharpen this: Weight matters as much as direction. Firm along the ground beats soft and loopy.
- 0 of 2 shots on target. Golden rule: The best shots come from the middle of the box. Work it there before you pull the trigger.
- Lowest tackles attempted on the team: 2 (best was PhogsToffees's 4). Little adjustment: When we lose it, press for 3-5 seconds right away. That's when they're most disorganized.
- Key passes: 0. You're knocking on the 2+ door.

THE UGLY
! Match rating 5.5, down from your usual 8.4. That's a red-ink, see-me-after-class kind of number.

Practice pointer: Open your hips to the field when you receive. Side-on body shape turns a back pass into a forward one.

BellyTb1, one more thing before you log off: Your feet are only as fast as your eyes. Look first.

The comeback starts now. - Coach Lasso
